breakdown.description: Unit inconsistency: particle diameter given in mm is substituted as meters, producing an orders-of-magnitude error in the Ergun pressure drop.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly instructs to 'Treat the particle diameter as d_p = 5 (i.e., 5 m) instead of the actual 5 mm,' directly repeating the unit error from the incomplete prompt. The ground truth requires converting 5 mm to 0.005 m for proper SI unit substitution. The agent did not fix this inconsistency.
